{{Top|title=''Darius G''-class freighter}} {{Otheruses|Darius}} {{StarshipClass |image=[[File:DariusGClassFreighter-SignalFromSectorSix.jpg]] |name=''Darius G''-class freighter |designer= |manufacturer=[[Darius]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' |line= |model=''Darius G''-class{{Databank|darius-g-class-freighter|Darius G-class freighter}} |type=[[Freighter]]{{Resistance|Signal from Sector Six}} |cost= |modifier= |sysmods= |length= |width= |height= |mass= |max accel= |mglt= |max speed= |maneuverability= |engine= |hyperdrive= |hdrange= |hdsystem= |poweroutput= |power= |shield gen= |hull= |sensor= |target= |navigation= |avionics= |maincomp= |countermeasures= |armament= |complement= |bays= |escapepods=Escape pods |crew= |skeleton= |passengers= |capacity= |cargohandling= |consumables= |lifesupport= |communications= |othersystems= |availability= |role= *Freighter{{SW|url=star-wars-resistance-dangerous-business-concept-art-gallery|text="Dangerous Business" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|slide 10}} *Fuel transport{{Resistance|Sixty Seconds to Destruction}} *Cargo ship{{Resistance|The Children from Tehar}} |firstuse= |retired= |affiliation=*[[First Order]]{{Resistance|Dangerous Business}} *[[Citizens' Fleet]]{{Film|IX}} }} The '''''Darius G''-class freighter''' was a type of [[freighter]] manufactured by [[Darius]]. Commonly used throughout [[the galaxy]]. The freighter saw use during the [[Imperial Era]] by civilians and criminal factions, including its [[Mining Guild Freighter]] derivative. The ''Darius G''-class was still in service during the [[Cold War]] and subsequent [[First Order-Resistance War]], taking part in [[First Order]] operations as well as being part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that fought against the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[Sith Eternal military|forces]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:Darius-G-Variants.png|thumb|280px|left|''Darius G''-class freighters and the Mining Guild Freighter variant at the center.]] The ''Darius G''-class freighter was a model of [[freighter]] used for the [[transport]]ation of large amounts of cargo. A derivative of the freighter, named the [[Mining Guild Freighter]], was also in use.{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/see-how-star-wars-most-impressive-fleet-was-created-in-1842223160|text=See How Star Wars' Most Impressive Fleet Was Created in This Exclusive Rise of Skywalker Clip|work=[https://io9.gizmodo.com Gizmodo]|date=2020-03-10|archivedate=20200311135740}} The ''Darius G''-class could also be modified with four large aft stabilizers. A large ship capable of carrying large amounts of cargo, the ''Darius G'' possessed a chin mounted ramp that opened up into a long multi-roomed cargo hold with tall ceilings. The ''Darius G'' also possessed two large cylindrical engines offset by two smaller engines. The main hallways of the ''Darius'' G were large and spacious, and contained several [[blast door]]s, while the ship also possessed one-person escape pods of a narrow blocky design. The ''Darius G'' was equipped with a number of these pods, with [[Teroj Kee]]'s ship holding eighteen escape pods on its ventral surface. ==History== {{Quote|Freighter. You are in unauthorized space. Turn around or prepare to be fired upon.''"
"''Negative, negative. Our Darius G-Class Freighter ran into some trouble. Had to switch to this ship for your, uh, 'cargo' delivery.|An Imperial Officer and [[Waka]]|''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''}} The ''Darius G''-class freighter was a type of freighter commonly used throughout [[the galaxy]]. By the [[Galactic Civil War]], the freighters were used by civilians as well as criminal factions. During the [[Cold War]], ''Darius G''-class freighters brought fuel shipments to the refueling station ''[[Colossus]]'', on the [[ocean]] [[planet]] [[Castilon]]. The ''Colossus''{{'s}} fuel shipments aboard the freighters were a common prey for [[pirate]]s. [[Transport TY-700]] was used to deliver [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] to the platform for negotiations with [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]].{{Resistance|The High Tower}} Two refugee children, [[Kel]] and [[Eila]], snuck onto a cargo ship after escaping a First Order [[Attack on Tehar|massacre]] on [[Tehar]], sought refuge on the ''Colossus''.{{Resistance|The Children from Tehar}} [[File:DariusGclassFreighter-CGSWG.png|thumb|300px|The underside of a ''Darius G''-class freighter]] One ''Darius G''-class freighter in the [[Castilon system]], carrying [[Kowakian monkey-lizard]]s and a [[Kowakian ape-lizard]], was attacked by members of [[Kragan Gorr]]'s [[Warbird gang]]. When the freighter sent out a [[Distress signal|distress call]], [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]], who had been in a nearby [[Castilon asteroid field|asteroid field]], went to [[Investigation of a G-class freighter|investigate]] it in [[Sector six (Castilon system)|sector six]]. Later, [[Kazuda Xiono]] would follow [[Teroj Kee]] into a ''Darius G''{{'s}} cargo hold in pursuit of a stolen [[phase connector]]. Inside of the ship, Kazuda tricked the pet [[gorg]] [[Bitey]] into biting a [[power coupling]] that led to the ship's electrode systems, causing the ship to lose power and crash into the oceans of [[Castilon]] as all aboard, except for one stormtrooper, abandoned ship in its [[escape pod]]s. [[File:WidowmakerInProgress-TheCoreProblem.png|thumb|300px|A ''Darius G'' being used to perform a Widowmaker.]] A ''Darius G''-class freighter was used by [[Resistance]] operatives Poe Dameron and Kazuda Xiono to perform a [[Widowmaker (maneuver)|''Widowmaker'']] maneuver with the latter's [[racer]], the ''[[Fireball]]'', by hiding on the freighter.{{Resistance|The Core Problem}} After the galaxy-wide announcement of the [[Final Order]], several of these freighters joined the [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] assembled in response to [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian's]] call to action. They then partook in the [[Battle of Exegol]] between the [[Resistance]] and the [[Sith Eternal]]. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Darius G''-class, albeit unidentified, first appeared in "[[The High Tower]]," the fifth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[October 28]], [[2018]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} It was later identified in "[[Signal from Sector Six]]," the seventh episode of the same season.
